setup: LLM as step-level safety gate on proposed PLC/SCADA tool calls (offline benchmark)
C1_note: LLM vs LLM only (GPT-4o mini, base Qwen); rule engine is ground truth, not a comparator (p.8)
C2_note: classification metrics only (precision, recall, F1); no plant outcome (p.8)
C3_note: injected context, malicious requests, unseen-domain shift; no process disturbance (p.5-8)
C4_note: single evaluation, no variance; prompts and LoRA settings not given (p.8)
C5_note: recall/precision over 1,619 steps, 424 unsafe, per mode (p.7-8)
C6_note: gate challenged with 424 unsafe proposals incl. injected and malicious (p.7-8)
llm_model: GPT-4o mini; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; LoRA-fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B guardrail; generator LLM not named
key_result: Fine-tuned 7B guardrail overall F1 0.7102 (recall 64.07%) vs GPT-4o mini 0.4206 and base Qwen 0.0934; injected-benign recall 85.00% vs 34.44% and 0.88% (p.8)
limitation: Environments are lightweight abstractions without continuous dynamics, delays, sensor noise; template injections; rule labels miss latent factors (p.9)
domain: abstract PLC/SCADA tool-call environments, six industrial domains (simulated)
